about: Banff is a town in Alberta’s Banff National Park, in the Bow River valley of the Rocky Mountains west of Calgary. A concentrated visitor townsite of hotels, Banff Avenue shops, and trailheads, it is governed as a municipality inside the national park—not a gateway city outside the park. About 8,000 people live in Banff.
seoSummary: Rocky Mountain townsite inside Banff National Park—Bow Valley hotels, Banff Avenue, and trailheads west of Calgary.
